title: Multi-target service fingerprinting & bucketing
description: Turn large scan results into actionable work buckets.
detail: After liveness/port discovery: 1) Parse results (nmap -oG/-oX, httpx json) into host->services. 2) Bucket: (A) mgmt/auth/VPN/remote access, (B) web apps/APIs, (C) databases/caches/queues, (D) ICS/OT protocols, (E) file/infra services. 3) Attach tech+version; map to relevant skills (web-exploitation, api-security, ad-attack, ot-ics-assessment, database-attack). 4) Create intents per bucket with clear scope; cap parallelism on fragile targets. 5) Reconcile with campaign graph to avoid duplicate work.
